$comment: Tool checks: each runs as a Playwright test that calls the tool and asserts on its response (see tests/*.spec.ts).
name: SQLite MCP Server Evaluation

checks.name: should query all users
checks.description: Direct query to get all users

args.query: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY id
SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM users

checks.name: should list all database tables
checks.description: List all tables in the database

args.query: SELECT name, role FROM users WHERE role = 'admin'

checks.name: should join users and posts tables
checks.description: JOIN query to get posts with user names

args.query: SELECT u.name, p.title FROM users u JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.published = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM posts WHERE published = 1
SELECT u.name, COUNT(p.id) as post_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.user_id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY post_count DESC
SELECT title, published FROM posts WHERE published = 1 ORDER BY id
SELECT name, email FROM users WHERE role = 'moderator'

checks.name: should get all posts by Alice

args.query: SELECT title, published FROM posts WHERE user_id = 1 ORDER BY id

checks.name: should calculate published vs draft ratio
checks.description: Calculate published vs draft posts ratio

args.query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN published = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as published, SUM(CASE WHEN published = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as drafts FROM posts

checks.name: should handle invalid SQL syntax gracefully
should exactly match user count
checks.description: Exact match validation for user count

args.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM users

checks.name: should show detailed users table structure
checks.description: Schema introspection - detailed users table structure

checks.description: Snapshot test for all users query result

args.query: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY id

checks.name: should match posts with users snapshot
checks.description: Snapshot test for posts with user information
